a-fully-leveled-bigshot-builds-a-farm-wi:
The full-level boss Lu Jingzhi crossed over.
Start with a thatched cottage, with three family members attached.
Lu Jingzhi gnawed on the bun and clenched her fists—rise up, she wants to rise up!
After all, he is the owner of the three-line ability, sitting on the space, with a lot of food, so is it possible that he will starve to death in the valley?
It’s just—something is wrong with my mother, what, she was reborn, and she was an imperial concubine in her previous life?
There is something wrong with my sister, what, is she a female president from modern times?
There is something wrong with my sister, what, she also wore it…
Lu Jingzhi was ecstatic… the whole family worked together, is it still far from the days of eating hot pot and living in a villa?
Hunting, farming, making jam, growing peppers, opening a milk tea shop… Life is getting more and more prosperous.
born-sacred:
Noah Blackwell never got a second chance.
He was assassinated the moment his story began, killed by a man who claimed to be Reborn from the future.
The reason was simple and terrifying:
In that future, Noah would become the Final Devil, a being whose hands were soaked in blood, a godlike existence that would end the world.
Noah found the accusation ridiculous.
He was ordinary.
He avoided trouble.
He had never taken a life, he hadn't even killed a chicken,
Then the Supreme Will descended upon Blue Star.
The world shattered overnight as humanity entered the Era of National Awakening. Every person awakened extraordinary abilities, and civilization was forced to evolve, or perish.
When Noah awakened, death itself rejected him.
EX-Rank Talent : Born Sacred.
No method could permanently kill him.
Upon death, he could resurrect instantly, or return safely elsewhere.
And as long as he breathed, his body, mind, and soul grew stronger... endlessly.
Control. Perfection. Infinite growth.
The power was absolute.
What should have been a blessing quickly became a curse.
Reborn individuals hunted him.
Organizations watched him in fear.…

Devastated by his fate as a side-character, he realises he's been transmigrated into the very novel he was criticising. In this cruel world where only the strong survive and magical beasts lurk everywhere, he's expected to live briefly and die meaninglessly until he hears it...

The Li family is extremely poor. With only four bare walls for a home, they don’t even have a woman to manage the household.
The Heavens had mercy today, Li family’s oldest son had saved a woman at the market and brought her back home.
Li Man was killed by her mother-in-law and transmigrated. She was almost hanged on the first day, but, fortunately, she was rescued by the Li brothers.

global-awakening-starting-with-ten-sss-r:
Fifty years ago, the First Red Moon appeared which changed Earth forever.On that night, tattoos across the world transformed into mysterious Divine Runes, granting their owners supernatural Talents.
Dimensional Gates followed soon after, bringing Dungeons and monsters. Humanity adapted. Awakeners became the pillars of civilization and an an enigmatic realm known as the Beyond became humanity's second battlefield.
Jet was born fifty years too late. Like countless others born after the First Red Moon, he could only watch the Awakened from below.
Then, when Jet was eighteen, the impossible happened. The Red Moon appeared for the second time. Every person carrying a tattoo was given another chance to awaken a Divine Rune.
Jet had none. He missed the greatest opportunity in human history by a single tattoo. Ten years later, still an ordinary man in a world ruled by the Awakened, Jet died protecting his little sister during a devastating Dimensional Impact.
But death wasn't the end.
Jet opened his eyes again, he was eighteen, exactly one month before the Second Red Moon.…
god-and-devil-world:
In less than an instant the world as we knew it was at its end.
That’s right. The Apocalypse. In a single blink Zombies appeared and mutated monsters began to rampage all throughout the world. Now it was the human species turn to fight for survival and planetary dominance!

Initially only hoping to get to his friends and escape to a refugee camp our protagonist sets out, inadvertently building a team along the way. After a series of fortuitous events and a few serious hunches our hero decides it’s time to do more than just survive!
Yue Zhong begins to form the foundations of an enormous survival plan... before he suddenly discovers that he has only gotten over the first hurdle.... Ethan was betrayed, he was broken, left crippled by those he trusted most: Zachary and Ivy, the people who ruined his life. Stripped of everything, Ethan crawled through three grueling years in the abandoned depths of despair, desperate to regain what he lost.
Until one final act of defiance opened the door to something greater.
When Ethan completed a hidden quest, fate granted him a miraculous reward: a second chance.
He awakens years in the past, on the eve of a revolution: the launch of Ethereal, the world's first fully immersive VR game and humanity’s obsession. Armed with memories of four years in Ethereal, he’s no longer the helpless pawn who lost everything.
This time, Ethan knows every secret, every hidden quest, every exploit to climb back to the top. But when he steps into the game, the system unveils a shocking twist: a divine bloodline, legendary abilities, and a class no one believed could dominate.
Ethan vows to rise once more, but this time, he knows where the paths of glory begin, where betrayal lurks, and where to find legendary treasures that will crown him king in this brutal new world.
The stakes are higher than ever.…

To save his friends, Raj grabbed him and jumped off the edge of the hill. He should have died there, but at the brink of death, a holographic window appeared in front of him, declaring that he carried a unique bloodline and teleported him into a world of magic.
He needed to survive there and find out the answers—why he was still alive, why he was teleported there, and how he could return to Earth.
But the more he explored this world ,the more he got tangled in its affairs, and realized his bloodline wasn't as simple as it seemed.

Born and raised as a nameless shadow guard for his kingdom’s crown prince, his life’s purpose was to be used and discarded at the whims of his liege.
And his meaningless life ended when the gaze of a princess lingered on him for too long. The crown prince had him beheaded without a second thought, as if throwing out trash.

transmigrationthe-villain-wants-a-happy-:
After finishing a tragic novel where the villain is betrayed and killed by his own beast husbands, Li Wei does what any reasonable reader would do. He rants about the ending.
Then he gets hit by a car.
When he opens his eyes again, Li Wei finds himself inside that very novel, reborn as Su Ningyan, the future villain destined to walk a path of madness, war, and blood.
Ten years before his fall.
Ten years before his death.
In the original story, Su Ningyan’s unstable phoenix beast core drives him toward forbidden power, turning him into a feared villain who ultimately dies at the hands of the men he loved most.
This time, Li Wei refuses that fate.
He will avoid the villian arc.
He will heal his beast core.
And he will stay far away from the four terrifying beast princes who will one day become his husbands.
Unfortunately, fate has other plans.
The academy meant to heal him becomes a battlefield of tension, rivalry, and instinctual bonds. The beast princes notice him far too early, and the more Su Ningyan tries to escape the plot, the tighter destiny coils around him.
Because in a world ruled by beast bloodlines and ancient bonds, some connections cannot be severed only delayed.…
